means.example-sentence: We all went out and took part in open-air exercise in spite of the bad weather.
means.sentence-jp: 私たちは全員悪天候にもかかわらず外に出て, 屋外での運動に参加した。

cloze.maskedText: We all went out and took part in open-air exercise ____ the bad weather.

notes: in spite of [despite] oneself は『思わず, 我知らず』。
